rationale: After 40 minutes in the trade and with only 25 minutes left until the mandatory market-on-close liquidation, upward momentum has stalled well below the $11.65 target. The last five 1-minute candles show a slow bleed lower from $11.42 to $11.37 on declining volume, compressing the price right down to the 5m 9-EMA ($11.35). With 5m ATR at just $0.05, the probability of an expansion to the take-profit before the close is low, making it prudent to lock in the small gain rather than risk a break of the moving average into the final minutes.
